fields.label: Source code folder
fields.description: Choose a repository, a folder with source and docs, or a Git comparison folder prepared for Software verifier suite.

choices.label: Extract docs and add custom rules

fields.label: Rule documents
fields.description: Current requirements separates historical reports, tutorials and code examples from obligations. Exclusions remain available for review.

fields.label: Specification paths
fields.description: Enter one path or pattern per line, relative to the source folder, such as docs/retries.md or docs/*.md. Leave blank to use Rule documents.

fields.label: Verification scope
fields.description: Enter approved checks as JSON. Leave blank for checks selected from the captured project.

fields.label: Runner evidence folder
fields.description: Select only when the scope uses independently pinned execution records.

fields.label: Case evidence SHA-256
fields.description: Optional digest of the recorded workflow, service, access and test-control evidence.

fields.label: Report context SHA-256
fields.description: Optional pinned collection methods, source locations and comparison check IDs.

web_ui.title: Software verification
web_ui.description: Review functional intent, verified defects, integration, authorization and independent test quality.

registration.writes: static-html web_ui.json handle in the run output

starter_questions: How can I try the synthetic code sample?
What must I review before approving the rules?
Which results are unknown, and what should we verify next?

setup_guide.introduction: Choose a source folder to start your review. I’ll prepare the rules for your approval, then assign checks to the specialists.

sample.title: Sample dispatch review
sample.description: Review two fictional revisions of a dispatch queue with independently recorded workflow, service, policy and test-control observations.
sample.expected_output: A reproduced queue regression, a policy configuration mismatch, the results of the existing tests and lint, and a tested repair for a surviving control.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll prepare the rule list from your selected inputs. When Review rules appears, check the wording before you approve it.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the report for the combined verdict, then select a specialist tab to inspect checks, evidence and gaps.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open report.md in the output folder to see the verdict and source evidence for each approved rule.
